# 2 Baruch Chapter 23 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

This log records all verses in 2 Baruch Chapter 23 where the three translators (EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA) significantly diverged in their renderings, along with SOPHIA's resolution and reasoning.

---

## 23:3 — "those who return to the dust / the dying"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "those-who-return [to-the-dust]" | Literal: Syriac uses a return-to-earth idiom for dying |
| LOGOS | "those who return to the dust" | Preserves the biblical idiom |
| PNEUMA | "the dying" | Simplifies for modern readability |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Retained EMET/LOGOS "return to the dust." The idiom echoes Gen 3:19 and is theologically apt in a resurrection context.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET/LOGOS. Biblical resonance preserved.

---

## 23:5 — "treasury / storehouse / chamber"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the-treasury-[of-souls]" | Brackets gloss for clarity; treasury of souls is a key concept |
| LOGOS | "the treasury" | Bare term, let context define it |
| PNEUMA | "a heavenly treasury" | Adds "heavenly" for orientation |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS bare "treasury." The term is plain in the text; context (ch. 21, 30) establishes the meaning. EMET's bracket is anticipatory; PNEUMA adds without warrant.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 23:7 — "the coming one / the Anointed One / the Messiah"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the-coming-[one]" | Literal: Syriac "the one who comes" — brackets implied |
| LOGOS | "the coming one" | Preserves the messianic title form |
| PNEUMA | "the one who is coming" | Paraphrase, same meaning |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS "the coming one." This is the standard messianic title form in 2 Baruch. All three largely agree; LOGOS is most concise.

**Status:** Consensus with minor phrasing variation.

---
